scope: All listed checks passed with the final production implementation.
Allocation measurements cover warmed target component updates / instrument mesh rebuilds, not whole-game GC or device FPS.
Previews use actual production components with explicit time stepping (25 fps, 60 frames) and fixture values. Shutter playback uses the controller duration settings.
Live captures use SampleScene with injected input and debug finish records. Physical pedals, target display hardware and on-device performance were not tested.
